title: Whole genome expression in meningioma

publications.title: Genome wide expression profiling identifies specific deregulated pathways in meningioma.

institution: Department of Human Genetics, Saarland University
platform: GE Healthcare/Amersham Biosciences CodeLink Human Whole Genome Bioarray (GPL2895)
sex_distribution: 18 female / 8 male (n=26, all samples including the 2 dura controls; live per-sample factors table)
age_distribution: Range 31-85 years (n=26, all samples including the 2 dura controls; live per-sample factors table)
processed_data_format: GSE12530_series_matrix.txt.gz (normalized signal intensities) plus per-sample CodeLink text files in GSE12530_RAW.tar
needs_manual_review_reason: DEEP-AUDIT ATTEMPT (2026-07-14): tried to verify corresponding_author ('Nicole Ludwig') against the paper's own correspondence footnote for PMID 19003955 (Int J Cancer, Wiley). Europe PMC's structured author-affiliation data returns only the first author's (Keller A) affiliation string and no email for any of the 10 authors (Ludwig N included), i.e. inconclusive rather than confirmatory. Direct fetch of the Wiley article (https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/pdfdirect/10.1002/ijc.23942 and .../doi/full/10.1002/ijc.23942) was blocked by a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge page on two attempts with different User-Agent strings (default and a Chrome/Windows UA); no PMC full text exists for this 2009 article (not deposited, isOpenAccess=N, inEPMC=N per Europe PMC). Semantic Scholar API was rate-limited (429) on retry. Per this audit's instructions, corresponding_author is therefore left UNCHANGED (not confirmed, not guessed) -- 'Nicole Ludwig' may or may not be correct; this needs a human with paywall access to verify. Authors array (10 names) already matches the full Europe PMC authorString exactly, no truncation found. Never previously fetched; identified only as a plausible candidate in this project's first search session (2026-07-10) and independently verified fresh this session via the live BioStudies API (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/api/v1/studies/E-GEOD-12530), which mirrors GEO series GSE12530, cross-checked against GEO's own acc.cgi record. Confirmed genuinely new (not represented under any other accession anywhere in this inventory; grepped for GSE12530 and PMID 19003955 across all of /data/, zero hits) and genuinely in-scope (24 meningioma + 2 dura controls, real human patient tissue, not a cell line). Grade breakdown (8 grade I / 8 grade II / 8 grade III, 2 dura controls with WHO 'not specified') and sex distribution (18F/8M) were confirmed directly from BioStudies' live per-sample Experimental Factors table (26 individual factor rows, each with AGE/HIST/SEX/WHO and a GSM linkage), not estimated from the series summary text alone; this table happens to reproduce the series summary's stated '24 meningioma including eight of each WHO grade and two dura controls' exactly. Publication (Keller et al., Int J Cancer 2009, PMID 19003955) confirmed via GEO's own Series_pubmed_id field and independently via PubMed esummary. tissue_preservation and who_edition are left 'Not reported' because neither the BioStudies record, the GEO SOFT text, nor the protocols subsections state a preservation method (only Trizol RNA extraction is described) or a specific WHO classification edition; per project convention this is not inferred from the 2008 submission date. Sex/age distributions are aggregated across all 26 samples (tumor + control together), not separately tabulated for the meningioma-only subset, since the live per-sample table does not flag a tumor/control axis distinctly from the WHO field itself. tags.large_cohort left false pending centralized quartile recomputation.
